criteria.note: Tier A meets the 2-year account-age bar; Tier B meets every other bar but has a younger account, and rides at half weight.

style_filter.note: Institution-style wallets (desk-scale tickets or >$1M weather notional) are removed. copy_trader mirrors BUYs and holds to resolution, so wallets that sell out of most positions ride at half weight rather than being treated as buy-and-hold.

shortlist.method: Ranked on trades that clear COPY_MIN_LEADER_NOTIONAL and on the PnL of those trades specifically, not on headline lifetime PnL. A wallet whose edge lives in sub-$50 dust produces no signal this bot can act on.

not_selected.ShyGuy1: most copyable volume (2,397) but only 2.2% ROI on them -- too thin to survive our slippage
not_selected.HenryTheAtmoPhD: 7.1% ROI but 0.52 copyable buys/day -- roughly one signal every two days
not_selected.387411007415611814: 2-year account, but only 59 copyable trades ever (0.51/day)
not_selected.securebet: 2-year account, 0.22 copyable buys/day and a 53% sell share
not_selected.Legend-: 15.1% headline ROI is entirely in $3 dust: 24 copyable trades ever, and they LOST $73

market_class.requirement: copyable flow must be in DAILY city-temperature / rain markets
market_class.why: Monthly climate markets ("hottest month on record", "temperature increase C") resolve off NOAA/NASA datasets weeks later. forecast_edge cannot price them and copying them locks capital for weeks.

example_rejected.why: Oldest account in the sample (863d) and trades 99% of days, but 0% of its 58 copyable buys were daily weather - all were monthly climate markets. Last copyable buy 2026-07-29. Profit also concentrated: top 3 trades = 57%. Avg entry 0.836 with 88% win rate; bootstrap 95% CI on ROI +1.0%..+12.8%.

selection.note: Two leaders only. Combined copyable signal is roughly 2 buys/day from KickstandBot; securebet has emitted none since 2026-08-07. Keep ENABLE_FORECAST_EDGE=true -- copy_trading alone will trade rarely.

traders.name: KickstandBot
traders._why: 0% sell share -- mirrors exactly how the bot holds to resolution. 10.0% ROI and 76% win over 115 resolved copied buys, all daily city-temperature markets, still buying today. Caveat: its copyable flow only began 11 days ago.

traders.name: securebet
traders._why: Best hold-to-resolution ROI of the shortlist at 17.3% over 98 copied buys spanning 18 months, 100% daily weather, 773-day account. Its 53% sell share is answered empirically: holding its buys to resolution is what produced that 17.3%. Caveat: no copyable buy since 2026-08-07.
